covers: The Wall Street open on Monday 23 Nov 2026, Nvidia's reinstatement of Jensen Huang, US rates, oil and gold, and South African news from the JSE session
headline: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO and its shares jump about 32% at the open; S&P 500 up about 4.8%, Nasdaq about 6.8%
summary: Nvidia said on Monday 23 Nov 2026 that Jensen Huang is back as CEO with immediate effect, and its shares were up about 32% to $165.61 just after the Wall Street open, pulling the S&P 500 up about 4.8% and the Nasdaq about 6.8% after last week's rout (Yahoo Finance, 23 Nov 2026). In South Africa, Coca-Cola HBC made its JSE debut with a value of about R341 billion, and the rand was quoted at R17.46 per dollar in Reuters copy at 14:03 GMT (Reuters via CNBC Africa, 23 Nov 2026), ahead of Moody's and S&P reviews late on Friday 27 Nov. Gold rose about 4.3% to near $3,668 and Brent fell about 3.2% to $87.08, while the US 10-year yield rose to about 4.94-4.97% as markets still price about a 91-92% chance of a Fed rate hike on 9 Dec (Yahoo Finance and Investing.com, 23 Nov 2026).

items.title: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO; shares up about 32% at the open
items.summary: Nvidia announced on Monday 23 Nov 2026 that Jensen Huang returns as CEO and president with immediate effect, 11 days after he resigned on 12 Nov. Board chair Harvey Jones said the board believes Huang "is the right person to lead NVIDIA"; the board's independent investigation into Huang's ties to a Megaspeed executive will continue to its conclusion, and Nvidia set up a National Security and Export Control Committee (Yahoo Finance, 23 Nov 2026). The shares were at $165.61, up $40.08 or 31.9%, at 09:30 New York time (16:30 SAST) (Yahoo Finance). President Trump had urged the board on Sunday evening to bring Huang back (Investing.com, 23 Nov 2026). Our BUY rating is unchanged; the price is still below our fair value estimate of $262.56.

items.title: Wall Street surges at the open: S&P 500 about +4.8%, Nasdaq about +6.8%, Dow about +2.7%
items.summary: Shortly after the open on Monday 23 Nov 2026 the S&P 500 was at 7,240.64 (+4.78%), the Nasdaq at 24,149.79 (+6.77%) and the Dow at 49,453.72 (+2.71%) (Yahoo Finance quotes, 23 Nov 2026). This follows seven straight daily falls for the S&P 500, which closed in a correction on Friday. Chip and AI-server names led: Dell +22%, Taiwan Semiconductor +16% and Micron +17% on Investing.com's movers list (23 Nov 2026). Early moves can fade during the day.

items.title: VIX falls about 23% to near 27.4; 10-year Treasury yield up to about 4.94-4.97%
items.summary: The VIX volatility gauge was at 27.41 (-23.6%) and the 10-year Treasury yield at 4.968% on Yahoo Finance quotes, and 4.939% on Investing.com, on Monday 23 Nov 2026. Polymarket gives about 91% odds of a Fed rate hike on 9 Dec (down from 98% on 12 Nov) and bond markets price about 92% (Yahoo Finance, 23 Nov 2026).

items.title: CrowdStrike to buy Zscaler for about $43.9 billion; CrowdStrike shares down about 9-10%
items.summary: CrowdStrike said on Monday 23 Nov 2026 it will buy Zscaler for $43.9 billion in shares. CrowdStrike fell 9.6% and Zscaler rose 13% in early trade (Yahoo Finance, 23 Nov 2026; 24/7 Wall St., 23 Nov 2026).

items.title: This week: HPE results tonight, Dell on Tuesday, PCE inflation Wednesday, markets shut Thursday
items.summary: HPE, Agilent and Zoom report on Monday 23 Nov 2026 (Yahoo Finance earnings calendar). Dell reports on Tuesday 24 Nov (Reuters via MarketScreener, 23 Nov 2026). US PCE inflation is due Wednesday, markets are closed Thursday for Thanksgiving and Friday's session ends at 13:00 New York time (24/7 Wall St., 23 Nov 2026).

items.title: Coca-Cola HBC lists on the JSE at about R341 billion ahead of its CCBA deal
items.summary: Coca-Cola HBC opened at R996 on its JSE debut on Monday 23 Nov 2026, reached R1,039.50 and traded at R990 by 11:26 GMT, valuing it at about R341 billion ($19.53 billion). It is buying a 75% stake in Coca-Cola Beverages Africa, a deal expected to close on 27 Nov, and will then handle about two-thirds of Coca-Cola system volumes in Africa. Reuters quoted the rand at R17.4577 per dollar (Reuters via CNBC Africa, 23 Nov 2026).

items.title: Rand firms 0.9% to R17.43/$; 2035 bond yield down 7.5 basis points to 8.63%
items.summary: The rand traded at 17.4325 per dollar at 06:34 GMT on Monday 23 Nov 2026, about 0.9% firmer, helped by higher commodity prices and a weaker dollar; platinum gained 1.2%. Umkhulu Treasury's Adam Phillips said the big number this week is US PCE inflation on Wednesday (Reuters via CNBC Africa, 23 Nov 2026).

items.title: WeBuyCars headline earnings per share fall 18.6%; founders step back, Wynand Beukes to be CEO from 1 Jan 2027
items.summary: In results for the year to 30 September 2026, published Monday 23 Nov 2026, WeBuyCars said headline earnings per share fell 18.6% to 182.8c even though revenue rose 7.2% to R28.3 billion and cars sold rose 4% to 186,220. The final dividend was cut 43% to 17c (full year 50c, from 60c). The company blamed pressure on gross margins in a falling used-car market, as cheaper Chinese and other Asian brands reached 20% of new passenger car sales in 2026. Co-founders Faan and Dirk van der Walt are stepping back; deputy CEO Wynand Beukes takes over as group CEO on 1 Jan 2027 (TechCentral, 23 Nov 2026). WeBuyCars is not on our coverage list.

items.title: Moody's and S&P reviews of South Africa due late on Friday 27 Nov, both on positive outlooks
items.summary: Both agencies are scheduled to publish their South Africa reviews late this coming Friday; each currently has a positive outlook on the country (BusinessTech Africa, 23 Nov 2026). An upgrade or a change in outlook would be a market-moving event for the rand and SA bonds.

items.title: Shoprite to buy back and cancel about 265 million deferred shares; Continental proposes closing its Gqeberha tyre plant
items.summary: Shoprite plans to buy and cancel about 265 million deferred shares held by Thibault Square Financial Services, with Titan receiving about 1.8 million new ordinary shares worth roughly R600 million; other shareholders' voting interest would rise from about 59.9% to 88.7%. Continental AG has proposed closing its Gqeberha tyre plant, which supports about 950 jobs, and the dtic plans urgent talks (BusinessTech Africa, 23 Nov 2026).

items.title: Gold +4.3% to about $3,668; Brent -3.2% to $87.08, WTI -3.0% to $80.92; dollar index +0.4%
items.summary: At the US open on Monday 23 Nov 2026 gold was at $3,668.20 (+4.35%) on Yahoo Finance and $3,663.60 (+4.22%) on Investing.com. Investing.com showed Brent at $87.08 (-3.19%), WTI at $80.92 (-2.99%) and the dollar index at 104.198 (+0.44%). Oil is adding to a three-week losing streak, with attacks on Gulf shipping limiting the losses (Reuters via Yahoo Finance, 23 Nov 2026). A stronger gold price helps JSE gold miners; a lower oil price helps South Africa's fuel bill.

items.title: Midday: Brent -3.8% to $89.04, WTI -1.4% to $82.82; gold +2.9% to $3,619, silver +3.4% to $42.41; rand flat at R17.46/$
items.summary: Prices at 12:48 SAST on Mon 23 Nov 2026. Oil has given back more ground since the morning, when Brent was near $92.65, while gold and silver extend their gains. Platinum was $1,302.20 (+1.0%) and copper $5.525/lb (+0.9%). EUR/USD 1.0975, GBP/USD 1.3112. Cheaper oil helps the fuel-price outlook for South Africa; firmer precious metals support JSE gold and PGM miners.
items.source: LRC Forex & Commodities scan / Yahoo Finance

items.title: Nvidia +31.9% to $165.61 after Huang's return (rating BUY, unchanged)
items.summary: Nvidia had closed at a 52-week low on Friday after losing about 23% in a week (Investing.com, 23 Nov 2026). Monday's jump follows the reinstatement of Jensen Huang (see Breaking). The board investigation and US government questions over chip sales to China remain open, so news flow is likely to stay heavy. Fair value estimate $262.56.

items.title: Meta +4.9% to $588.48; Dell +22% and AMD +5% (all rated SELL, unchanged)
items.summary: Investing.com quotes on Monday 23 Nov 2026 showed Meta at $588.48 (+4.93%), Dell at $340.44 (+22.45%) ahead of its results on Tuesday 24 Nov, and AMD at $446.03 (+5.10%). Meta remains below our fair value estimate of $677.14; AMD is above its $402.73 estimate. No company-specific news for Intuit, Deckers or Paylocity was found today.

items.title: MTN at R221.80 and Telkom at R66.37 going into the week
items.summary: Both closed lower on 20 Nov 2026 (MTN -1.3%, Telkom -1.0%) but telecoms remain the JSE's relatively strongest group in recent trading (LRC Stock Scanner; Unum Capital, 22 Nov 2026). No ratings have changed.
